subtitle.own: Your visits, orders, sales and collections for the period.
subtitle.team: Totals for your team; open a name to see one person.
subtitle.all: Company totals, by territory and by brand.

VISITS_PLANNED.name: Planned visits
VISITS_PLANNED.definition: Visits planned for the period, one per customer per day. Cancelled visits are excluded.

VISITS_COMPLETED.name: Completed visits
VISITS_COMPLETED.definition: Completed visits, counting one per customer per day (Cairo calendar day of check-in).

VISITS_VERIFIED_PCT.name: Verified visit rate
VISITS_VERIFIED_PCT.definition: Completed customer-days with a GPS-verified or approved-exception check-in ÷ completed customer-days × 100.

VISIT_AVG_MINUTES.name: Average visit (minutes)
VISIT_AVG_MINUTES.definition: Average time from check-in to check-out of completed visits, in minutes.

CUSTOMERS_ADDED.name: Customers added
CUSTOMERS_ADDED.definition: Customer records created in the period by the employee, leads included.

NEW_ACCOUNTS.name: New accounts
NEW_ACCOUNTS.definition: Customers whose first invoice is in the period. Leads without an invoice do not count.

ORDERS_BOOKED.name: Orders booked
ORDERS_BOOKED.definition: Orders submitted in the period. Cancelled or rejected orders do not count; a cancellation after the period closed (day 5 of the next month) is subtracted in the month it happens.

BOOKED_SALES.name: Booked sales
BOOKED_SALES.definition: Value of booked orders excluding VAT (subtotal − discount). Orders are pipeline, not revenue.

APPROVAL_TURNAROUND_HOURS.name: Approval turnaround (hours)
APPROVAL_TURNAROUND_HOURS.definition: Average hours from submitting an order to its approval, for orders approved in the period. Lower is better.

SALES_FULFILLED.name: Sales fulfilled
SALES_FULFILLED.definition: Value of posted fulfilments excluding VAT: fulfilled quantity × net unit price of the order line.

NET_REVENUE.name: Net invoiced revenue
NET_REVENUE.definition: Invoices issued in the period excluding VAT (subtotal − discount), minus credit notes issued in the period (excluding VAT).

CASH_COLLECTED.name: Collections confirmed
CASH_COLLECTED.definition: Payments received in the period and confirmed by finance, VAT included. Payments awaiting verification are excluded. A closed month is never restated: a payment confirmed after its month closed counts when it is confirmed, and a later bounce or reversal counts as a negative amount in the period it happens.

AR_OPEN.name: Open receivables
AR_OPEN.definition: What customers owe at the end of the period (or today), VAT included: the sum of positive customer ledger balances. Attributed to the customer's current primary rep.

AR_OVERDUE.name: Overdue receivables
AR_OVERDUE.definition: Open amount of invoices past their due date at the end of the period (or today): total − allocations − credit notes, VAT included.

STOCK_ALERTS.name: Stock alerts
STOCK_ALERTS.definition: Active variants at or below their reorder point, plus lots in sellable warehouses that expire within 90 days. Company level, live.

PENDING_APPROVALS.name: Pending approvals
PENDING_APPROVALS.definition: Approval requests waiting for a decision about employees in your scope. Live.
